reason: Meeting Portal operational-readiness repairs authorised for 48 hours. Preserve all existing signature, resend, upright stamping, EAT, placed-position and saved-signature confirmation behaviour. No secrets, SMTP settings, Firestore rules, certificates, hashes, archive logic, or standard Worker deployment workflow changes.

activityLog.description: Opened the 48-hour Meeting Portal repair window from the user-authorised request. Rollback baseline is production commit 433727282012c75cdaebca21dcdadcb28dba59fb.
Inspected current main, registered Meeting Portal protection, and added portal-protection smoke coverage on an isolated branch. No production changes.
Connected the seven-portal protected regression runner to the full test:all command; all seven portal entries are executed by the existing portal smoke script.

Expanded the isolated browser fixture to mount Meeting Room, seed clearly labelled TEST participants, exercise governance controls and signing mocks at 360/412/768/1280px, and trigger the workflow for every repair branch. No real emails or production data.
Removed the push branch allowlist entirely so every repair branch can trigger the isolated Meeting Portal workflow; extended its path filters and paired isolation-guard assertions.

Extracted the existing source-isolation gate into a shell script and rebuilt the dedicated fixture workflow as a minimal explicit job; this preserves the path allowlist and avoids the previous zero-job workflow failure.
Removed the fixture workflow's cancel-in-progress concurrency rule so the PR-triggered verification is not cancelled by concurrent branch push runs. The source-isolation gate remains mandatory.
Added the repair-window declaration itself to the dedicated fixture workflow path filters, ensuring the latest authorised repair-window revision receives the same browser regression.
Corrected a malformed regular expression in the extracted workflow-isolation regression test. The first real job now reaches the policy test instead of failing at JavaScript parse time.
Added the repair-window declaration to the extracted isolation allowlist so the fixture workflow can validate its own authorised repair evidence.
Aligned two legacy isolation-guard policy assertions with the already-present email-link identity exception; the policy logic itself is unchanged.
Adjusted Playwright selectors to target the actual Meeting Room form-field structure rather than inaccessible sibling labels. No application UI behavior changed.
Fixture now explicitly selects Physical Venue before entering the venue, covering the venue branch of meeting scheduling rather than only the default online room.
Expanded the isolated fixture to mount the real Resolutions register, create a TEST resolution linked to the scheduled meeting, and open its linked vote before exercising Meeting Room voting.
Corrected the browser selector for Meeting Room's actual unlabeled meeting selector. The test remains browser-driven against the real portal component.
Added explicit quorum-assessment synchronization and a global assertion that every fixture action records emailSent=false.
